score: emulator against Google's reference results, 4,748 claimed cases: 2,230 pass, 196 wrong, 49 error not raised, 1,095 rejected by the emulator, 853 tables or parameters it cannot build, 41 time zone, 279 unscored, 5 crashes
caveats: This scores the emulator, not the prover. Expected values are Google's reference results, not BigQuery's; eight classes were checked on real BigQuery (docs/emulator-gaps.md). Tables holding NaN or infinity cannot be built on the emulator, so those cases are unmeasured. The untrusted list is built from the development files; BETWEEN was added after reading the held-out failures (tuned on test). Harness rules (time zones, NULL versus empty array, signed zero, narrow GoogleSQL number types) were fixed on the development files before the held-out run.
